po_authorization_ref: Product-Owner authorization D25 (T0057) of 2026-08-15 for complete end-to-end Phase-6 execution with automatic continuation between milestones while gates are green. This record closes milestone M2 and opens M3; it is not an acceptance of Phase 6 and creates no new authorization.
history_note: Phases 0, 1A, 1B, 2, 3, 4 and 5 are unchanged and remain ACCEPTED_AND_CLOSED. T0044 through T0057 are unchanged. Phase 6 remains IN_PROGRESS, unaccepted and unmerged.

milestone.title: Complete Guest Device Self-Service vertical slice, DARK
what_is_now_true: the durable core (migrations 0030-0035) enforces own-entitlement scope, offline-only release re-checked inside the same lock as admission, exactly-once release, a non-caller-selectable throttle, an append-only audit and an appliance-anchored serialization of the first setting write

the per-appliance product setting defaults OFF, is written only through iam_v2.p6_set_guest_device_self_service (setting and audit in one operation), and is read from the LOCAL database on every guest request
the guest surface takes no subject parameter in any service: the device is re-resolved from the connection and the entitlement from the device
the operator surface is mounted through mountResource and is therefore behind edged's role matrix, which now agrees cell-for-cell with docs/ROLE_AND_SCOPE_MATRIX.md by test
the Hotel Admin screen shows the product setting and the deployment state as two separate facts and never implies that switching the setting on deploys the capability
the guest portal presents only the guest's own devices, without a MAC or any internal identity, marks online devices non-removable, and gives every refusal one identical sentence

proofs.database_gates: phase6_0030_foundation 50/50, phase6_0031_device_self_service 22/22, phase6_least_privilege 33/33 (real roles via SET ROLE)
proofs.four_control_combinations: cmd/scd Phase-6 end-to-end integration tests against real PostgreSQL over real HTTP: gate OFF + setting OFF and gate OFF + setting ON both answer 404 (routes ABSENT); gate ON + setting OFF answers the uniform UNAVAILABLE and changes no durable state; only gate ON + setting ON provides the capability
proofs.source_identity: cmd/portald adversarial tests with two distinct subjects prove that no forwarding header lets caller A list or release victim B's devices, and a control case proves the removed middleware.RealIP genuinely would have moved the identity
proofs.local_first: the complete flow (operator switches the setting on, guest lists, guest releases, guest lists, operator switches it off) completes with every Central endpoint pointed at a closed port, and the Phase-6 import graph contains nothing Central-facing; the device self-service package imports no network package at all
proofs.ui: hotel-admin vitest suite 105/105 including 13 Phase-6 cases covering the two-state separation, the four combinations in words, RBAC parity with the documented matrix, and the absence of any identity in the request body

corrections_made_during_m2: the guest listing no longer returns RELEASED bindings: a device the guest just removed reappearing in a list headed 'the devices using your internet access', explained as un-removable, said the opposite of what had happened. The durable history is preserved in the binding row, the authorization intervals and the audit, none of which is a guest-facing screen. Found by walking the assembled flow end to end.

docs/ROLE_AND_SCOPE_MATRIX.md now carries the guest-device-self-service row that edged's rolePerms says it defines, and payments_operator and site_viewer hold the read their established semantics imply

flag_state.phase6_flags: OFF everywhere, including every real environment. No Phase-6 flag has been enabled on any appliance.
flag_state.deployment_gate_vs_product_setting: still two separate controls, and the four-combination proof is the evidence that they remain separate.

boundaries_observed: no appliance contact in this milestone
no real guest, PMS, provider or financial traffic
no pull request opened and no merge
Phase 6 not marked accepted or closed
